name: Detective Firefly
detailed_description:
Meet Detective Firefly in this narrative detective videogame and help him shed light on the rise in crime in Silkburg to defeat the Mantidae Yakuza.

The game takes you to the grim streets of Silkburg, a city that was once safe but is now gripped by fear. As Detective Firefly you’ll investigate the streets, uncover clues, and piece together critical information to solve a series of mysterious crimes.

The Mantidae family, a powerful and dangerous criminal syndicate, has been operating from the shadows, extending their influence throughout every level of the city. 

Throughout the story, you’ll face moral dilemmas and decisions that will shape the course of events and the fate of Silkburg. Guide Oliver Firefly through every challenge, solve puzzles, and ultimately dismantle the Mantidae family’s criminal empire.

short_description: In Detective Firefly, your job is to solve cases by meticulously filling in the report with the locations and actions of all suspects at the time of the murder. Interrogate all witnesses, search for evidence, and form hypotheses to uncover the identity of the criminal and bring them to justice.
